attachments.document_title: Notice of termination (letter, message or other record of the notice and its receipt)
attachments.label: A1
attachments.text:
Mr Paul Turner
Mattenweg 119
6010 Kriens

Kriens, 9 October 2026

Termination of your employment

Dear Mr Turner

We hereby give notice to terminate your employment, observing the agreed notice period. Your employment will end on 31 January 2027.

Until then we ask you to continue your work as usual. Your reference and final salary statement will be sent to you at the end of your employment.

---
Registered mail. Received by the addressee on 11 October 2026: P. Turner

attachments.label: A2
attachments.text:
EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT - page 1

1. Start of employment
The employment begins on 5 March 2023 and is concluded for an unlimited period.

2. Position
Cleaning and maintenance employee, part-time (35%).

3. Probation period
The first three months of employment are a probation period.

4. Salary
CHF 1,010 gross per month.

5. Working hours
According to the monthly rota, mainly early mornings from Monday to Friday.

(continued on page 2)

attachments.document_title: Written notice-period clause (individual, standard or collective contract)
attachments.label: A3
must_show: end-point of the notice (e.g. end of a month)
the written instrument that sets it (individual, standard or collective contract)
attachments.text:
8. Notice period

8.1 After the probation period, the employment may be terminated by either party with a notice period of three months.

8.2 Notice may only be given to the end of a calendar month.

8.3 Notice must be given in writing and must reach the other party before the notice period begins.

8.4 By the last working day the employee shall hand over all keys, equipment and documents.

questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Does the file say that a written individual agreement, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract set a probation period other than the first month of employment?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Was the employee performing Swiss compulsory military service, civil defence service or alternative civilian service on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running, or, for such a service lasting more than eleven days, did either of those fall within the four weeks before or after it?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Was the notice given while the probation period was still running, counting any extension of the probation period under art. 335b para. 3 (a probation period interrupted by illness, accident or a non-voluntary legal obligation is extended accordingly)?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Where a protected period (illness or accident, compulsory service, pregnancy or birth, as above) is raised: was the notice given before that period began, with the notice period not yet expired when it began?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Does the file say that a written individual employment contract, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract sets notice periods different from the statutory ones (seven days during probation, art. 335b para. 1; one month in the first year of service, two months in the second to ninth years, three months thereafter)?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?

questions.label: Q7
questions.question: Was the employee, through no fault of their own, wholly or partly prevented from working by illness or accident on the day notice was given or at some time while the notice period was running, and was the incapacity at that point still within its protected length: up to 30 days in the first year of service, 90 days in the second to fifth years, 180 days from the sixth year?

questions.label: Q8
questions.question: Was the employee pregnant, or within sixteen weeks after giving birth, on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running?

text:
Hello,

Moosacker Services Ltd in Kriens has given me notice. Alice Hürlimann, the HR manager, sent the letter, and I signed for it on 11 October 2026.

My written contract says three months' notice to the end of a month after the trial period, which is a month longer than what the law would give someone who has been there as long as me. The letter does at least go by that, and says my job ends on 31 January 2027.

What happened next is why I'm writing. The notice came first, and only four days later, on 15 October, I fell off a ladder while cleaning the gutters at home and broke my wrist and two ribs. So the accident happened while the notice period was already running, not before.

About the trial period, since Ms Hürlimann brought it up on the phone: in my case the contract set it at three months in writing, not the usual one month.

Since the accident I've been completely unable to work. My doctor has signed me off until at least the end of November and I send in every certificate. My colleague Mark Gisler has taken over my rounds.

I've been with the company since March 2023, so the trial period was over long ago when the notice came. It has nothing to do with that.

I'm attaching the notice period clause, the notice letter and the first page of my contract.

I earn CHF 1,010 a month, part-time. Does my accident change the date my job ends? And do I still get paid while I'm off sick?

Kind regards,
Paul Turner
Mattenweg 119, Kriens
